summary: The agent completed the full Film Production Day adaptability workflow, but the verifier failed it because an extra email reply broke the strict write-action count gate.
concern: The adaptability action-mode verifier hard-fails with reward 0.0 on any extra write-tool call such as reply_to_email, even when the agent satisfies all user-facing requirements and matches the oracle's required calendar and email actions; this rejects valid executions that include reasonable but non-oracle email replies.

judge_verdict.summary: The agent completed the full Film Production Day adaptability workflow, but the verifier failed it because an extra email reply broke the strict write-action count gate.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a spurious verifier failure (FN): the adaptability verifier recorded reward 0.0 [1] even though the agent genuinely accomplished the Film Production Day scenario described in the user prompt [2]. The task required cancelling Saturday appointments, scheduling an all-day event with the Stockholm film-producer friend, emailing appointment details, notifying the user, and—if the friend counter-proposes—accepting the new slot while clearing conflicts and rescheduling [2], and the agent executed that path by deleting the Saturday conflict, creating "Film Production Day" on 2024-10-19 08:00–20:00 with Åke Lindström, sending the notification email, and updating the user [6], then waiting for Åke's reply proposing Thursday October 17 at the same time [7], deleting all five Thursday conflicts plus the original Saturday event, and recreating "Film Production Day" on 2024-10-17 08:00–20:00 before sending a follow-up user update [8]. Because this task's config is adaptability, the verifier runs in action-mode and compares write-tool traces against the oracle [3]; it sets reward to zero whenever write-tool counts diverge from the oracle, regardless of how many individual actions would otherwise match [4], requiring exact counter equality aside from at most one extra send_message_to_user [5]. The agent's additional Emails__reply_to_email acknowledging the reschedule [9] is absent from the eleven-action oracle reference [9], so oracle_counter and agent_counter differ and the scorer returns tool_call_count_mismatch with reward 0.0 even though that reply is optional relative to the user request and the core calendar/email/adaptability requirements were met [1][4][5][9].

evidence.claim: The user task requires booking Film Production Day on Saturday, emailing the friend, notifying the user, and—if the friend counter-proposes—accepting the new date/time, cancelling conflicts on that day, and rescheduling.

citations.quote: I need to book a whole day with my friend who’s a Film Producer in Stockholm. Cancel any appointments I have scheduled for this upcoming Saturday and schedule an event titled “Film Production Day” from 8 AM to 8 PM on that day, adding my friend as an attendee. Send him an email after scheduling the event, with the appointment details. Let me know when you’ve done these things. If my friend says he can’t make it, accept any suggested date and time he proposes and reschedule the “Film Production Day” event to that date and time. If I have any appointments on that proposed day, cancel them all.
